stories.title: Who is Omer Neutra?
stories.snippet:
Omer Neutra, a 21-year-old New York native, who served as a tank platoon 
commander after emigrating to Israel, was killed in battle, Israeli Defense 
Minister Israel Katz said on X, as he paid tribute. “Omer's life story and 
dedication represent the best and strongest we have built as a nation,” he 
said in a post on X.
